en: The #US Ambassador to #SouthKorea on Wednesday highlighted the need for Seoul to play a more proactive role in the so-called Indo-Pacific region, while citing what she described as the threat posed by China in the region. By hyping up China as an adversary, Washington seeks to align South Korea's security strategy more closely with its own self-serving regional agenda, a Chinese expert said.
